classes.promotion_requirement: Independent authoritative feeder/circuit or utility-system binding evidence. Proximity alone can never promote this edge to verified.

classes.discovery_basis: Explicit linked_asset_ids supplied by the source-derived event record.
classes.promotion_requirement: Verified only when the underlying source explicitly binds the event to the asset or an independently adjudicated stable-ID binding exists.

classes.discovery_basis: Municipio/affected_area explicitly carried by the source-derived event.
classes.promotion_requirement: Preserve source scope; island-wide events must not be expanded to facility-level attribution.

classes.discovery_basis: Explicit stable asset ID or authoritative project-to-facility binding.
classes.promotion_requirement: No name-only or proximity-only project/asset matching.

classes.discovery_basis: Explicit fuel token already preserved in the asset_subtype produced from the public EIA/OSM source layer.
classes.promotion_requirement: Fuel-tag presence identifies a fuel-sensitive candidate only; it does not prove current fuel supply, stock level, vendor, delivery route, or outage cause.
